flagged.location: sources.references, as applied to Postulate clause (iv), “Unsharp finite outcomes”
flagged.evidence: Current clause (iv) adopts a “finite family” of effects for finitely many channels, but the listed references are Teschl §2.1, Tong §§3.2–3.3, and Binney–Skinner §1.4. I checked those sections: they cover self-adjoint or Hermitian observables, Born probabilities from eigenstate expansions, and ideal sharp measurement. They do not substantiate the finite unsharp-effects/POVM extension. That extension is adopted as a postulate, but the current references do not support this clause.

coverage_note: Checked all 15 scoped carriers, the measurement and instrument definitions and the trace, rank-one, Kraus, and partial-trace suppliers needed for their arguments, and the cited sections relevant to the P2 citation finding. I checked zero-probability and angle-endpoint cases. The reviewed examples make model claims; I did not assess laboratory realization.
